subject: Security review kickoff & scope clarification - Zenith Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@zenithhealth.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@zenithhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-25T16:10:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps - Security kickoff

Thanks again for your time today - great conversation. As promised, quick recap and proposed next steps from Redwood:

- Goal: kickoff security review so we can get you a SOC-2 summary and answer your questionnaire items related to data flows, retention, and encryption.
- Systems potentially in scope (please confirm): user-facing API endpoints for inference, backend model serving infra (hosted & dedicated), logging/audit trail, and SSO/KMS integrations.
- Action items:
  1) Zenith to share completed security questionnaire (we can accept XLSX / PDF).
  2) Redwood to provide SOC 2 summary, network diagram, and high-level data flow.
  3) Align on economic buyer & procurement path so we can start contract conversations.

Proposed owners: Lena (security) to lead questionnaire intake; Mark (procurement) to lead purchasing steps. Internally I'll coordinate with Rishi (AE) and Neha (Solutions) for technical artifacts and timelines.

Suggested timeline: get questionnaire back this week -> Redwood returns artifacts within 3 business days -> quick follow-up call to confirm anything outstanding.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (stub)

Would you confirm the systems in scope and whether there are any other teams we should include? Happy to set a kickoff Zoom - propose Thurs 2/26 10:00am PT or Fri 2/27 9:00am PT.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@zenithhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@zenithhealth.com>
Cc: Mark Chu <mark.chu@zenithhealth.com>
Date: 2027-02-26T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps - Security kickoff

Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. Quick notes from security:

- We're attaching the questionnaire we use for vendor reviews (it's the procurement/security combined intake). Please fill the technical sections you can; we'll focus on the items about data residency, encryption, and access controls.
- Systems in scope: confirm the list below is accurate for our review window:
  * API endpoints that accept PHI/pseudonymized data
  * Model hosting (hosted + dedicated pools)
  * Audit logs and retention systems
  * SSO and KMS integrations for key management
  * Any on-prem/private deployment footprints (if you have customers with on-prem)

We may also ask for a network diagram and high-level runbook for incident response.

Procurement: Mark - please advise on the typical PO/contract path and any preferred SOW language.

I'll aim to return questionnaire items within 2 business days after we get Redwood's SOC2 and network diagram.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of InfoSec, Zenith Health
lena.ortiz@zenithhealth.com
[Attachment: zenith-questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Mark Chu <mark.chu@zenithhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@zenithhealth.com>
Date: 2027-02-27T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps - Security kickoff

Marissa - quick procurement note: our legal team will typically request a standard SaaS MSA + SOW. PO path is two approvals (budget owner + Sourcing). Can you confirm whether Redwood uses our standard MSA or requires a vendor counter? Also would like a ballpark of expected contract value so I can flag internal stakeholders.

If you can send a draft SOW or typical pricing ranges that would help speed approvals.

Best,
Mark Chu
Senior Procurement Manager, Zenith Health
mark.chu@zenithhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@zenithhealth.com>, Mark Chu <mark.chu@zenithhealth.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@zenithhealth.com>
Date: 2027-02-28T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Security review kickoff - scope confirmation + next steps (internal + external)

Internal / external combined update: thanks everyone for the quick replies. Status and immediate next steps:

- Zenith questionnaire received (attached by Lena). Lena, thanks - we'll fill technical sections and return by EOD 2/28.
- Rishi: can you prepare the draft SOW/pricing ranges to share with Mark? Use the DEEP pack (hosted + optional dedicated pool) pricing model; include an estimate for a 12-month committed Dedicated pool + overage.
- Neha: please pull the network diagram and high-level data flow for hosted and dedicated variants. If we reference any on-prem options, note differences in key management and support.
- Sean: please compile SOC2 summary + any additional audit artifacts we can share (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf is a start).

I'll coordinate and aim to send the completed questionnaire and SOW draft to Zenith by EOD 2/28. If we hit blockers, I'll request a 30-minute follow-up with Lena/Mark next week.

Cheers,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: completed-zenith-questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
